headline: Rayman Legends Retold delayed to December
title: Rayman Legends Retold December 3 | Delayed From October | Gaming News
video_script: Rayman Legends Retold now launches on December third, twenty twenty six. Ubisoft delayed it from its planned October first date, saying the game has already gone gold but the team wants extra time to polish every detail. It comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC. The classic platformer is getting a fresh retelling. Are you ready to run and jump again? Comment below!
description: Rayman Legends Retold is delayed from October 1 to December 3, 2026, and launches on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC.
